name: praxis
description: A lean engineering framework: one loop with optional stations — design, spec, decision, plan, execute, issues, campaign, review, verify — with human gates and durable connected artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: A lean engineering framework for capable agents
interface.longDescription: Praxis is one loop with optional stations — EXPLORE, DECIDE, CONTRACT, PLAN, EXECUTE, PROVE, DELIVER — where each skill loads only when its activity is present and skipping stations is never a violation. using-praxis routes on durable state first, then activity. Plans pass a human acceptance gate before execution; plan-governed PRs pass a human review gate. Campaigns keep long-running initiatives' synthesis and open questions durable; artifacts connect by typed links; worker reports are never completion proof. Durable local artifacts default to .agents/ unless the repository declares an owning surface.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the one Praxis skill whose engineering activity is present, and keep ordinary work direct when no skill boundary is needed.
